item.title: Ador faces NewJeans comeback dilemma as financial pressure mounts
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Ador is facing a growing dilemma over NewJeans' comeback as the prolonged hiatus of its sole artist takes an increasing financial toll on the agency. The company's ongoing legal battle with former CEO Min Hee-jin and former NewJeans member Danielle adds to the uncertainty surrounding the group's return. item.title: AKMU to release first-ever Christmas single
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Sibling duo AKMU is set to release its first-ever Christmas single, “The Guest,” on Dec. 1, marking a surprise return with new music ahead of the holiday season. The duo announced the upcoming release via its official social media channels Wednesday, unveiling a retro-style poster featuring the two members in festive outfits. item.title: Hyukoh returns with first full-length album in six years
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Hyukoh returned Wednesday with its new studio album, "33," marking the indie band's first full-length release in six years. According to its agency DooRooDooRoo Artist Company, the band spent nearly three years working on the album in Seoul, Bath in the UK and Berlin, exploring themes of loss, anxiety and the love that endures through such experiences. item.title: Zerobaseone’s Kim Jiwoong to drop 1st solo EP
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Kim Jiwoong of Zerobaseone will release his first solo album on his birthday, WakeOne Entertainment announced Wednesday. A recent teaser clip for “Noise in Blue,” set for a Dec. 14 release, featured a TV screen filled with static and the singer posing under blue-toned light.
